comparison: Passes cheap smoke screen and ring_extension endurance like empf-v8, but regresses relative to empf-v8 on target_shift_recovery (FAIL vs PASS) and zero_tanh_rail_escape (FAIL vs PASS), and fails all three 100-mode tasks.
conclusion: On the untouched Tier-3 long-horizon holdout view (seed 0, zero tuning, 3840.6s), rhbi-v12 passed 8/18 tasks (two_pole 0.9954, unused_token_hold, ae_gan_hold, clockfree_audit, zero_tanh_smoke 0.0039 MAE, mode_hold 1.0000 hq, ring_hold conv=1400, uninterrupted 7500-step ring_extension 300/300 checks), failed 5 tasks (zero_tanh_rail_escape sustained window with final 0.0047 MAE, target_shift_recovery 45/81 live checks min_hq=0.7805, grid100 prec=0.2068, rotated100 0.2028, staggered100 0.2960, gating all three 14k continuations), and hit the 900s timeout INCOMPLETE on five_word_joint_smoke (gating five_word_joint_hold).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Evaluate frozen rhbi-v12 without tuning under protocol seed 0 on the Round-3 Tier-3 long-horizon holdout suite (14,000-update fresh-process native continuations grid100_14k/rotated100_14k/staggered100_14k, 7,500-update uninterrupted ring_extension, 4,000-update five_word_joint_hold, target_shift_recovery, zero_tanh_rail_escape, and 3-task cheap smoke screen).
next_action: Record in reports/forge/studies/r3-calibration-holdout.md as long-horizon baseline reference; do not promote over empf.
